releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.52 — the chat list and the small WhatsApp details. Swipe a chat right to archive it, left to mark it read; the Archived row at the top opens the archive where any chat can be put back or opened. All / Unread filter chips keep the list honest. Messages now render *bold*, _italic_, ~strikethrough~ and `monospace` exactly like WhatsApp — and only when the markers really wrap text, so 2 * 3 * 4 stays arithmetic. Long-press any message for Pin (a banner under the header, tap it to jump, ✕ to unpin) or Info (from, chat, type, exact time, delivery state, edited/forwarded/starred).
